title: Effective Steps for Troubleshooting Business Central Agents
summary: This post explains how to troubleshoot Business Central agents by examining task logs, step-by-step operations, and detailed agent actions. It covers analyzing agent reasoning, reviewing data visibility, adjusting agent permissions and profiles, and monitoring Copilot credit consumption.
key_points: Agents perform work in discrete steps, and you can view each step's description, reasoning, and details in the Agent Tasks page
The View Log Entries shows how an agent navigated pages and invoked actions; View Details reveals what data and tools the agent accessed
Adjusting agent permissions, creating tuned profiles with limited role options, and controlling data visibility improves agent performance and reduces token usage
Monitor Copilot credit consumption to understand agent costs; each credit costs $0.01
